title: Astraea Qdrant Payload Schema
description: Required payload structure for all jurisdiction collections. Scrapers must produce chunks conforming to this schema.

document_id.description: Unique stable identifier for this chunk. e.g. 'NZTT/2024/AKL/12345/chunk-3'

court.description: Machine-readable court code used for Qdrant payload filtering. e.g. 'NZTT', 'NSWCAT', 'NZLEG'

court_name.description: Human-readable court name shown in the UI. e.g. 'Tenancy Tribunal', 'NCAT'

title.description: Case or document title. e.g. 'Smith v Jones [2024] NZTT Auckland 1234'

date.description: Decision date in ISO 8601 format. e.g. '2024-03-15'

url.description: Canonical public URL for the source document.

source_type.description: Source type used for authority ranking.

citation.description: Neutral citation string if available. e.g. '[2024] NZTT Auckland 1234'

chunk_index.description: Zero-based index of this chunk within the source document.
